scope_reason: The shared pieces of the entity draw path (shadow, fire quads) change the compared pixels.

members.name: func_147906_a
members.note: the name plate: RendererLivingEntity draws it only for a custom-named living (a name set by an anvil, which world.conf switches off; an unnamed name tag names nothing) or another player (single player has none), RenderItemFrame for a named stack (anvil again); RenderPlayer's own is refused for the view entity (func_110813_b)

notes: The concrete doRender chains live in raster_mobs.c (living entities: the RendererLivingEntity pass loop, shadows, hurt flashes) and raster_entities.c (paintings, dropped items, XP orbs). The shared quad rasterizer is raster_entity_quad.h's entity_clip_vertex + raster_entities.c raster_entity_quad. Shadows are gated by the mobs_* scenes in out/java/render/. lane/idxclient: func_147907_a is the shadow's block quad (ported); name plates are unreachable (no custom names without the anvil; no other players).
